title: Measuring and mitigating overreliance is necessary for building human-compatible AI
reasoning: The paper is a position paper focusing on the phenomenon of human overreliance on Large Language Models (LLMs) from a human-computer interaction (HCI) perspective. While it mentions 'ethical judgments' as a domain where lack of benchmarks makes overreliance hard to detect, the paper's core objective is the measurement and mitigation of trust-related behaviors, not the evaluation or benchmarking of ethics, morals, or religion itself.
